title:
If fetchSpec is present in the input: Transforms a JSON including a template `slotIndex` and {@link BulkModelConfigApplicationState} into an object of
default hyperparameters, override hyperparameters to be further transformed by {@link ModelConfigHyperparamOverridesTransform}.

If fetchSpec is not present in the input: Uses the same inputs to return the number of hyperparameters.
name: BulkModelConfigHyperparametersGridTransform
